description.narrative: The primary objective of this IDF is to strengthen the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) of the Parliament of Ghana in its financial oversight role through capacity building, public outreach and advocacy.# Ghana's Parliament has as part of its functions the approval of budget estimates for Ministries, Municipalities, Departments and Agencies (MMDAs), sub-vented agencies and state enterprises as well as approving loans and grants for the country. Parliament exercises its oversight role on the use of these public funds through the Public Accounts Committee (PAC). This twenty-five man committee thoroughly reviews the audit report of the Auditor General of the Ghana Audit Service (Ghana's Supreme Audit Institution) on the audited financial statements of the MMDAs and other state enterprises. Following this review, public hearings are organized at which heads of these institutions are invited and made to answer questions on the key audit findings in their respective institutions.# The activities of the PAC have generated a lot of public interest and are expected to significantly improve financial accountability and transparency within Ghana's public financial management system. This project seeks to strengthen the PAC as part of the Bank's ongoing work in the area of improving corporate governance and PFM in Ghana. TF099406 The development objectives of this grant are to: (i) assist the PAC to review backlog of outstanding audit reports (ii)train members of district level Audit Report Implementation Committees (ARICs) , and (iii) make PAC review findings publicly accessible on a dedicated PAC website.
